inv.desc_en:
NO AGENCY FEES!

Property from an investment fund in a bidding period until, the starting price is the one indicated in the advertisement, the highest bid will win.

Premises, converted into a dwelling, located on the ground floor of a residential building. It has an interior layout, with rooms and services, such as a kitchen, 1 toilet, and 1 bathroom. In a consolidated residential neighborhood near Pradolongo Park, it has all the necessary basic services, surrounded by educational centers, supermarkets, and local shops. All this, in addition, with excellent communications by public transport (metro - bus) and roads. Request more information without any obligation.

Sale subject to VAT.

Note: Taxes and expenses not included (notary, agency, registry, VAT).
